description:
Create, list, show and delete person files in people/.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files, open ones only by default; QUERY is an optional fuzzy search ranked by similarity
  show PERSON [--json] — show a single person file; PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md
  new [--name NAME] [--category CATEGORY] — create a person file
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list: --all include closed people; --json JSON output
  show: --json JSON output
  new: --name full name; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]
  ["delete", "Riaz Arbi", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts interactively for any field not supplied. Always pass both --name and --category so it never reads stdin.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given, and removes the file permanently.
  A person file must exist before `tasks set-assignee` will accept that name.
  People are link targets only; they cannot be used as a thread.
